description: Get one app's top-free chart position per day in one storefront, as ranking_position and created_at points. The chart is the overall chart (category_id 36) when the app holds as many days there as in its own category over the asked span, otherwise its category chart, so a different span can answer from a different chart; category_id in the answer names it. Look back 1 to 3650 days (default 30). Use it for trends and for explaining a move; use get_rankings for a whole chart on one day. Top paid and top grossing history is not collected.

app_id.description: App Store ID of the app

days.description: Number of days of history (1-3650, default: 30)

name: get_ranking_history
title: Get ranking history
